theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → ∃ Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (P + 1))) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Z ∧ ∀ (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (P + 1))) (m + 1)) (φ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (x : Eucl P) (v : Fin m → Eucl P), (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x v = (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (P + 1)) (m + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ (v i))))) → Z η = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (φ s)
